gpt.text:
Run the three commands in order, then sanity-check the produced artifacts before promoting anything.

## 1) Run AUB autopilot (select best module candidate)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_autopilot.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --run --select-best
```

What to look for after it finishes:
- A report/log indicating which module candidate (if any) beats the current champion (`baseline/champion_v5_latest.json`).
- Whether it produced a new “PASS” candidate or left you with none (your handoff currently shows none).
- Any output files under your usual results directory (often `baseline/reports/` or `baseline/runs/`, depending on your repo conventions).

If it selects a best candidate, confirm:
- It improves the target metric(s) you care about (you have both `tuning_*` and `lockbox_*` stats in the handoff).
- It doesn’t regress lockbox min badly (your current lockbox min is ~1.134; keep an eye on tails).

## 2) Run system autopilot (system-level candidates)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/system_autopilot.py \
  --spec experiment_system/config/system_candidates.yaml \
  --run
```

What to check:
- Which system candidate(s) were evaluated and their scores vs the champion.
- Any “INCONCLUSIVE” outcomes and why (variance, timeouts, failed evals, insufficient samples).

## 3) Generate the next-fix plan (actionable patch list)
```bash
python3 experiment_system/tools/aub_next_fix.py \
  --registry experiment_system/config/module_registry.yaml \
  --output baseline/reports/next_fix.md
```

Then open:
- `baseline/reports/next_fix.md`

This should give a prioritized list of fixes (often: failing tests, flaky evals, underperforming modules, missing config entries, etc.). If it suggests changes, apply them and re-run step (1).

---

## Quick triage guide if results are “no PASS candidates” again
- **Check failures/timeouts** in logs first; many “no PASS” cycles are caused by infra/eval instability.
- **Compare tuning vs lockbox**: if tuning improves but lockbox regresses, you may be overfitting—tighten selection criteria or increase lockbox weight.
- **Verify champion file path**: ensure tools are actually using `baseline/champion_v5_latest.json` as the baseline and not an older default.

If you paste the stdout summaries (or the generated report paths) from steps 1–2, I can help interpret which candidate (if any) should be promoted and what the next fix should target.
